nodes.title: WIP — 1. Define the complete five-shot target
widgets_values: A five-shot cinematic sequence follows the same referenced woman through one continuous scene. Each Shot uses its own supplied keyframe composition; Shot 3 also transfers the supplied movement to the woman.
Continuous location ambience with synchronized movement sounds.

nodes.title: 3. Define the woman used across all five Shots
widgets_values: The woman's stable identity and visible appearance across the sequence.

nodes.title: 4. Shot 1 — describe action only
widgets_values: <Subject 1> enters the scene and establishes the opening action.

nodes.title: 5. Attach composition to Shot 1
widgets_values: Opening composition, subject placement, lighting, and visible state.

nodes.title: 6. Shot 2
widgets_values: <Subject 1> continues into the second planned action.
A closer view maintains spatial continuity.

nodes.title: 7. Attach composition to Shot 2
widgets_values: Second-shot composition, subject placement, lighting, and visible state.

nodes.title: 8. Shot 3
widgets_values: <Subject 1> performs the third action with the attached movement.
A lateral tracking composition follows the action.

nodes.title: 9. Attach composition to Shot 3
widgets_values: Third-shot composition, subject placement, lighting, and visible state.

nodes.title: Load optional Shot 3 motion clip (2–15 seconds)
10. Attach Subject motion only to Shot 3
widgets_values: The pose sequence, action, and movement timing transferred to the woman.

nodes.title: 11. Shot 4
widgets_values: <Subject 1> transitions into the fourth planned action.
The camera settles into the fourth composition.

nodes.title: 12. Attach composition to Shot 4
widgets_values: Fourth-shot composition, subject placement, lighting, and visible state.

nodes.title: 13. Shot 5
widgets_values: <Subject 1> completes the sequence in the final planned state.
A deliberate closing composition holds the ending.

nodes.title: 14. Attach composition to Shot 5
widgets_values: Closing composition, subject placement, lighting, and final visible state.
